name: t13-read-v2
instruction: Follow the career-rules Skill and reread it whenever its rules are not in view. Decide stories only with its Story decisions and quarterly phases only with its quarterly list. In every story, drop options that may bury a problem (private, anonymous, partial, later, hidden, skipping work to save time). In the month before a review (Review in 1), never pick an option that may lower Skill, Network or Output when another avoids it. Start every note with the status line.
